##### Project general facts

Ayana Heights Seaview Residences is a premium residential project designed as an extension of the legendary AYANA Resort Bali. The concept of the development is centered around elevated coastal living, combining panoramic ocean views, refined architecture, and a five-star lifestyle. Positioned as a high-end investment and private residence, the project offers exclusivity, privacy, and seamless integration with one of Bali’s most prestigious hospitality brands.

The project provides access to an extensive range of world-class amenities and services associated with the AYANA ecosystem. Residents benefit from landscaped areas, swimming pools, wellness and fitness facilities, restaurants, and beach clubs, as well as premium hotel-style services. The infrastructure is designed to deliver a resort-level experience, ensuring comfort, safety, and a lifestyle centered around relaxation and leisure, while also enhancing rental attractiveness.

The residences are thoughtfully designed with spacious layouts, floor-to-ceiling windows, and high-quality finishing materials that emphasize natural light and ocean views. Interiors reflect a modern tropical aesthetic, combining elegance with functionality. Units are delivered fully furnished and equipped, providing a turnkey solution ready for immediate living or rental. The combination of premium location, developed infrastructure, and fully furnished makes Ayana Heights Seaview Residences a strong choice for both lifestyle buyers and investors.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Phuket is the largest island in Thailand and one of the most popular tourist destinations in Southeast Asia, known for its white-sand beaches, tropical climate, and developed infrastructure. The island offers a unique combination of natural beauty and modern lifestyle, with luxury resorts, international restaurants, shopping centers, and entertainment venues spread across different areas. Its accessibility, including an international airport, makes Phuket convenient for both short-term visitors and long-term residents.

One of the key advantages of Phuket is its diversity of locations and lifestyles. Areas such as Patong are known for their active nightlife, while places like Bang Tao and Rawai offer a more relaxed and residential atmosphere. The island also features some of the most beautiful beaches in Thailand, including Nai Harn Beach and Kata Beach, making it attractive for both tourists and expats.

From an investment perspective, Phuket remains one of the strongest real estate markets in the region. Stable tourist flow, high demand for short-term rentals, and continuous infrastructure development support property value growth. The island attracts international buyers thanks to its lifestyle appeal, climate and profitability opportunities, making Phuket a reliable choice for both personal use and investment in resort real estate.
